children: Shares of pest control firm Rentokil Initial are trading at their most attractive valuation in a long time, RBC Capital Markets analyst Andrew Brooke writes. Rentokil shares are down 27% year-to-date but RBC is confident the stock is on the right path to recovery and sees "significant upside" if investors are patient with management. RBC has an outperform rating on the stock and price target of 480 pence. Rentokil shares are down 0.9% to 323 pence. (joseph.wilkins@wsj.com)
